title: Tiny, cute hammer
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- handle -->
    <rect x='46' y='38' width='8' height='52' rx='4' fill='#c98a4b'/>
    <rect x='46' y='38' width='3' height='52' rx='1.5' fill='#e0aa6d'/>
    <!-- handle end cap -->
    <rect x='44' y='86' width='12' height='6' rx='3' fill='#8f5f2e'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <rect x='20' y='14' width='60' height='26' rx='8' fill='#9aa7b8'/>
    <!-- head top highlight -->
    <rect x='24' y='16' width='52' height='6' rx='3' fill='#c4cfdd'/>
    <!-- head face front -->
    <rect x='22' y='24' width='56' height='14' rx='5' fill='#7d8a9c'/>
    <!-- head shine -->
    <rect x='28' y='26' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#d8e2ee'/>
    <!-- left claw -->
    <path d='M20 20 Q10 20 12 29 Q14 36 22 32 Z' fill='#8a98aa'/>
    <!-- right claw -->
    <path d='M80 20 Q90 20 88 29 Q86 36 78 32 Z' fill='#8a98aa'/>
    <!-- cute eyes on head face -->
    <circle cx='42' cy='31' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a20'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='31' r='2.6' fill='#3a2a20'/>
    <circle cx='42.8' cy='30.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='58.8' cy='30.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M46 34.5 Q50 38 54 34.5' stroke='#3a2a20' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- cheek dots -->
    <circle cx='37' cy='34' r='1.4' fill='#e8949a'/>
    <circle cx='63' cy='34' r='1.4' fill='#e8949a'/>
  </g>
</svg>
